name: GIF Captioner
author: alanfortlink
description: Search Giphy, caption a GIF, and copy the captioned GIF and MP4 to the clipboard, from a bar widget.

barWidget.description: Search Giphy, caption a GIF, and copy the result (GIF + MP4) to the clipboard.

schema.label: Keyboard shortcut
schema.description: Opens the panel from anywhere, e.g. SUPER ALT G or ALT SHIFT G. Registered with Hyprland while the widget is enabled; leave empty for none.

schema.label: Copy to the clipboard as
schema.description: A clipboard claim carries one representation. A file reference keeps the animation when you paste it into a chat; GIF image pastes the frames straight into an editor but often arrives as a single frame.
